programs.description: A military officer returns home to find his village stuck in the past, under the thumb of an abusive landlord. He urges them to revolt against their oppressor and learns a dark secret about his past.
David, a politically active person, is married to Rosy. However, when his political idol, mistreats his wife, he vows to take revenge.
Vishnu is on his way to Chennai from Coimbatore to join a new company and meet his fiancée. However, his plan is jeopardised upon meeting Pavithra on a train, who is stuck in a problem.
Saradha and Muthaiah, a village-based couple, face financial difficulties while raising their two sons, Ramanathan and Ramalingam. Problems escalate when Ramalingam gets his girlfriend pregnant.
Framed and jailed, honest cop Bheeshmar considers revenge after his wife dies, but ultimately decides to start anew with his child instead of seeking payback.
Dheeran, an aggressive journalist, is dedicated to his work and faces many challenges while trying to expose a bottled water company that is causing harm to people.
Mariyaan Joseph, a fisherman, is forced to take up employment in Sudan after his girlfriend faces financial issues. However, he finds himself in danger after crossing paths with some extremists.
